rationale: The parabolic event is already resolved — price opened high, spiked to $15.45, and has flushed 35% off the top to sit in the bottom fifth of the range, so entering short here means selling into an extended decline near the low while entering long means betting on a second leg with volume collapsed to ~1-2k shares per 5-minute bar and only 21 minutes left. The ~198 bps spread means any position starts roughly 2% underwater, which dwarfs the expected drift of a thin, momentum-exhausted $93M float. With no catalyst, no clear side in control (price hovers just above session VWAP and the 9-EMA), and squeeze/flush risk in both directions on a 9.6M float, there is no mechanical edge worth paying the spread for.
